arxiv-2510-04427.description: Abstract Recently, a class of efficient spectral Monte Carlo methods was developed in FSX 25 for solving fractional Poisson equations. These methods fully consider the low regularity of the solution near boundaries and leverage the efficiency of walk-on-spheres algorithms, achieving spectral accuracy. However, the underlying formulation is essentially one-dimensional.

pmc-11326836.title: The Ability of a 3-Gene Host Signature in Blood to Distinguish Tuberculous Meningitis From Other Brain Infections
pmc-11326836.creator: Julie Huynh, Le Hoang Thanh Nhat, Nguyen Le Hoai Bao, Hoang Thanh Hai, Do Dang Anh Thu, Trinh Thi Bich Tram, Vu Thi Mong Dung, Do Dinh Vinh, Nghiem My Ngoc, Joseph Donovan, Nguyen Hoan Phu, Dang Van Thanh, Nguyen Thi Anh Thu, Nguyen Duc Bang, Dang Thi Minh Ha, Ho Dang Trung Nghia, Le Van Tan, Le Hon

We investigated whether a 3-gene host response signature in blood can distinguish TBM from other brain infections.MethodsThe expression of 3 genes (dual specificity phosphatase 3 [DUSP3], guanylate-binding protein [GBP5], krupple-like factor 2 [KLF2]) was analyzed by RNA sequencing of archived whole blood from 4 cohorts of Vietnamese adults: 281 with TBM, 279 with pulmonary tuberculosis, 50 with other brain infections, and 30 healthy controls.

pmc-11359218.title: Rootstock Effects on Fruit Yield and Quality of ‘BRS Tainá’ Seedless Table Grape in Semi-Arid Tropical Conditions

pmc-11359218.description: In viticulture, choosing the most suitable rootstock for a specific scion cultivar is an efficient and cost-effective way to increase yield and enhance the physicochemical characteristics of the fruit. The objective of this study was to evaluate the agronomic performance of the ‘BRS Tainá’ grapevine on different rootstocks under the conditions of the Sub-Middle São Francisco Valley.
